h1
Every day, 61,200 vehicles cross the Charles River Dam road bridge by the Museum of Science in Boston.
h2
Built in 1906 and rebuilt in 2011, its substructure and its channel protection are each rated four out of nine. That is Poor.
p1
In the federal bridge inventory, Massachusetts has 5,252 bridges, and 444 of them are rated Poor.
p2
Those Poor bridges carry about ten point one million vehicle crossings every single day.
p3
2,600 bridges cross water. 778 need underwater inspection, done by divers today, and 123 are scour critical.
c1
Scour is the river eroding the bed around a bridge's foundations, and it is invisible from above the water.
b1
In one day, a team of three built a system that inspects a bridge above and below the water, in simulation.
d1
The drone is a Holybro X-five-hundred, flown by real Ardu-Pilot through a thirty-eight item mission in auto mode with Q Ground Control.
d2
It carries an Ouster 3D lidar, a gimbal RGB camera, floodlights, and a thermal camera, which is labelled simulated.
d3
Over open water it sees 12 satellites. Under the deck, its G-P-S drops to 7.
d4
So we cannot trust G-P-S where the inspection matters most, in the shadow directly beneath the bridge.
r1
Below the surface, the R-O-V is a Blue R-O-V two Heavy, flown by the real ArduPilot Sub autopilot, with no G-P-S at all.
r2
It navigates on a Doppler velocity log fed to the autopilot's filter, like the real Blue O-S setup.
r3
Its imaging sonar reaches 12 meters across a hundred and thirty degree field, beside a low-light camera built for turbid water.
r4
In our test, measured drift was about zero point four meters after 60 meters of travel.
t1
The two robots work together. The drone flags defects at the water line as it flies.
t2
The R-O-V is then tasked automatically to dive and inspect the wall directly below each flag.
t3
In our recorded run the drone flagged 4 defects, and the R-O-V inspected all 4 of them.
t4
The result is one 3D model: two point nine six million lidar points above the water joined to one point five eight million sonar points below.
a1
An A-I triage model, built with Kiro, scores all 5,252 Massachusetts bridges for underwater inspection risk from condition, scour, age, and traffic.
a2
Its number 1 is the North Washington Street bridge over the Charles, scour critical, a mile from our site.
l1
To be honest about limits: this runs in simulation, the thermal is simulated, and the defect flags come from ground truth.
c2
Above and below the waterline, in one pass, as one model. So the next inspection knows exactly where to send a diver, before anyone gets wet.
